Ex-US Senate candidate Jeff Greene sues 2 Florida 
newspapers for libel after his election loss 
By CURT ANDERSON 
The Associated Press 
Updated: 7:45 a.m. Thursday, Sept. 2, 2010 
Posted: 6:40 p.m. Wednesday, Sept. 1, 2010 
Failed Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Jeff Greene is suing two Florida newspapers for libel over articles 
Greene claims cost him votes. 
The billionaire ex-candidate is seeking $500 million in damages from the St. Petersburg Times, The Miami 
Herald and reporters and editors. The lawsuit was filed Wednesday in Miami. 
Greene said the papers published knowingly false stories and an editorial implicating him in a California 
mortgage fraud case. Another story involving boxer Mike Tyson detailed allegations of illegal drug use aboard 
Greene's yacht, which Greene also says is false. 
Greene said the stories were instrumental in his loss in the Democratic Senate primary last week. 
Times editor Neil Brown called Greene's alegations preposterous and called his newspapers coverage fair, 
clear and well documented. Top editors at the Herald did not immediately respond.

I was able to get in touch with Luis Galan from Cipriani over the weekend. He informed me that they do 
not have an integrated Cisco\Skype solution. He indicated that they used a VoIP Solutions provider who 
sent them several Cisco Phones that connected to the service providers phone switches over the 
internet. All phone administration and configuration is handled by the service provider. 
We have a very similar solution here at 301 E 66`" Street. Our service provider sent us phones to plug in 
at each user's desk allowing a single internet connection to provide telephone service and data services. 
Real Time services like Voice over IP and Video IP are often impacted by data packets arriving out of 
sequence or with high latency (round-trip time between packets). We continue to experience high 
latency from the USVI to the other locations. At FTC we are frequently using all of the 1.5Mbps 
bandwidth. Packets arriving when we have reached capacity are stored in the cache on the router and 
can be discarded if they are not transmitted before their expiration. If we are to use Real time services 
like Skype and Video Conferencing in the future from this location, we will probably want to increase our 
existing bandwidth and possibly switch providers. 
On a separate note, Emad indicated that employees travelling to the USVI will be staying at Dave 
Christopher's house. I'm not sure what type of services currently exist there and was wondering if I 
should schedule a time in the near future to visit. Let me know if this is ok. 
Thanks, 
WM

decided to
